about:
Sixty-one values of the nonlinearity parameter B/A of organic liquids at atmospheric pressure, as Table 8.3 prints them over its two panels: a substance, a temperature, a value and the reference the value comes from, which the row carries in attributed_to with the reference list of the chapter spelled out. The page names a substance on the first of its rows and leaves the name blank on the rows under it; every row here carries the name. Several substances are measured more than once and each measurement is a row of its own, which is where this quantity shows its spread: toluene prints 5.6 at 20 °C and 8.929 at 30 °C, from two different references. Four values print a plus-or-minus, held in uncertainty.

The page prints the 1-pentanol row twice, identically; it is held once, and the repetition is registered in docs/ERRATA.md. The caption gives the pressure as atmospheric and prints no number for it, so no row holds a pressure.
